review_question: What problem is the model intended to address?
Are data sources appropriate documented and lawful to use?
What assumptions equations parameters and constraints are used?
Does the implementation match the intended logic?
Is the model fit for its intended use?
Who approved the model and under what limits?
How will users access interpret and apply the model?
How will drift misuse or failure be detected?
What evidence triggers recalibration or redesign?
When should the model stop being used?
